fields.summary_ko.0: Walmart (WMT) is trading at $127.52 ahead of Q3 earnings on November 19, at a 46.0x PER multiple, historically experiencing three consecutive declines when PER exceeds 40x.
fields.summary_ko.1: Based on 31 earnings dates since February 2019, higher PER does not necessarily correlate with larger stock declines, but at PER above 40x, the probability of decline is 58% (7 out of 12 instances).
fields.summary_ko.2: In all three earnings dates in 2026, the company started with PER above 40x, experiencing declines of 1.4%, 7.3%, and 9.2% in February, May, and August respectively, followed by a 22.8% rebound.
